meta.title: Commercial Contract Heading Taxonomy

tags.u: Universal boilerplate — appears in nearly every commercial contract
tags.s: Shared — common across a family of contract types
tags.x: Signature — distinctive to this contract type

notes: Each heading carries a canonical concept key (c) so overlap can be computed across contract types.
Ordering reflects the representative order found in real templates and SEC EDGAR exhibits.

contracts.name: Mutual NDA
contracts.blurb: Self-contained information-protection contract. Notably missing the full risk-allocation stack (indemnity, liability caps, force majeure) found elsewhere.

sub: NDA term vs. surviving confidentiality term (1-yr sharing / 2-yr confidentiality benchmark)

optional: Residuals clause (unaided-memory use)
Non-solicitation rider
Affiliate-sharing rider

contracts.name: Master Services Agreement
contracts.blurb: Framework contract: legal terms live here, commercial specifics live in SOWs incorporated by reference. Carries the full risk-allocation stack.

sub: Each SOW incorporates MSA, forms separate contract

contracts.name: SaaS Subscription Agreement
contracts.blurb: Shares ~70% of its skeleton with the MSA. The SaaS delta: SLA + service credits, auto-renewal mechanics, suspension rights, DPA/subprocessors, data portability.

sub: Authorized Users, Customer Data, Documentation, Order Form
Plan, seats, fees, term — the commercial front page
Service credits as sole and exclusive remedy

contracts.name: Statement of Work
contracts.blurb: Project-shaped rider under an MSA. Deliberately thin on boilerplate — the MSA carries it. Nearly everything here is operational.

headings.t: Incorporation of MSA; Order of Precedence
Scope of Work / Description of Services

sub: Itemized outputs with formats, specs, due dates

optional: Project-specific terms varying the MSA (special IP or liability treatment)

contracts.name: Supply / Purchase Agreement
contracts.blurb: Goods-flow contract: the signature machinery is forecasting, POs, delivery/Incoterms, title & risk, and inspection/acceptance.

contracts.name: Distribution Agreement
contracts.blurb: A supply agreement wrapped in a relationship: appointment, territory/exclusivity, minimums, trademark license, and end-of-relationship inventory mechanics.

sub: Consequence of shortfall: loss of exclusivity or termination

contracts.name: IP / Software License
contracts.blurb: Built around the grant: scope, restrictions, and reservation of rights. Royalty/audit machinery and source-code escrow are the enterprise tells.

contracts.name: Executive Employment Agreement
contracts.blurb: Compensation architecture plus exit mechanics: the signature content is Cause/Good Reason definitions, severance, change-in-control, and restrictive covenants.

contracts.name: Consulting / Contractor Agreement
contracts.blurb: The employment agreement's mirror image: services-and-deliverables shaped, signature Independent Contractor Status section, present-assignment IP, no severance/benefits/409A.

sub: Kept lighter than non-compete to avoid misclassification

contracts.name: Commercial Lease
contracts.blurb: Property-law vocabulary all its own: CAM pass-throughs, SNDA, estoppel, quiet enjoyment, holdover, casualty/condemnation. Limitation of liability is rare — replaced by exculpation clauses.
optional: Retail extras: Percentage Rent, Co-Tenancy, Continuous Operation, Signage

contracts.name: Franchise Agreement
contracts.blurb: A license + operating system + relationship contract in one: grant, territory, fee stack (initial fee, royalty, ad fund), marks, operations manual, and post-term de-identification.

sub: Limited, non-exclusive license to operate under the System

contracts.name: Loan / Credit Agreement
contracts.blurb: Article-structured and covenant-driven: CPs → Reps → Affirmative/Negative/Financial covenants → Events of Default/Acceleration. Force majeure is conspicuously absent — lenders don't excuse payment.

headings.t: The Credits / Terms of the Loans

sub: Inability to determine rates / benchmark replacement
Closing: loan docs, opinions, certificates, KYC
Each credit event: bring-down of reps, no Default

optional: Conversion / Exchange article (convertible loans)
Appointment of lead borrower as borrowers' agent (multi-borrower deals)
Guaranty & security often housed in separate documents
No standalone financial-covenants article in some deals (covenant-lite / ratio used only for pricing)

contracts.name: Joint Venture Agreement
contracts.blurb: Governance-centric: capital contributions, reserved matters, deadlock mechanisms (Russian roulette, Texas shoot-out), transfer restrictions (ROFR/tag/drag), and exit buy-sell.

sub: Capital calls; failure-to-fund: dilution, default loans

contracts.name: Share Purchase Agreement (M&A)
contracts.blurb: The M&A deal contract — here in UK locked-box style: Leakage covenants instead of price adjustments, W&I insurance instead of seller indemnities, and reps that don't survive closing. Definitions sit at the back, not the front. US-style SPAs swap in escrows, purchase-price adjustments, and a full indemnification article.

sub: Sale free and clear of liens
Closing deliveries & payments: payoff of indebtedness, resignations, expense statement
Locked-box: Leakage reps and pound-for-pound recovery
Tax, employee benefits, IP, property, material contracts
Conduct of business between signing and closing
No survival of reps & warranties (locked-box hallmark)

optional: US-style variants: purchase-price adjustment, escrow, standalone indemnification article, disclosure schedules
Appendices: closing deliverables, permitted leakage
Exhibits: joinder, voting power of attorney, allocation schedule

contracts.name: Logistics Services Agreement (3PL)
contracts.blurb: Third-party logistics: a services skeleton (appendix-driven scope, order of precedence) crossed with goods-custody DNA — customer keeps title, the 3PL waives its warehouseman's lien, KPIs gate termination, and disaster recovery gets its own section.

sub: Whereas clauses: SERVICES, GOODS, DC definitions

headings.t: Hours of Provision of the Services

sub: KPI failure for consecutive months as termination trigger
No other fees or charges payable
3PL liability regime for goods in custody

headings.t: Integrity of the Agreement; Amending Conditions

sub: Waiver of warehouseman's / carrier's lien over customer goods
Customer owns all right, title and interest in the goods

headings.t: Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity & Change Control

optional: Appendices A–E: services scope, rate schedule, and incorporated operational exhibits

contracts.name: Merger Agreement (Public M&A)
contracts.blurb: Public-company M&A, organized around the deal lifecycle: merger mechanics → stock conversion → dual reps articles → signing-to-closing covenants → conditions → termination with break fees. Like the locked-box SPA, reps don't survive closing — but here it's because target shareholders are cashed out.

sub: Certificate of incorporation and bylaws of survivor

headings.t: Effect on Capital Stock; Exchange of Certificates
sub: Treatment of options and equity awards

headings.t: Representations & Warranties of Parent and Merger Sub
sub: No prior activities of Merger Sub
Form S-4 / proxy statement; shareholders meeting

optional: Two-step tender-offer variants
Support / voting agreements as side documents

contracts.name: Security Agreement
contracts.blurb: The credit agreement's companion — organized around collateral, not the deal: grant of security interest → UCC perfection → per-collateral-class articles (securities, IP, accounts) → foreclosure remedies. The agent gets attorney-in-fact powers and the security interest 'continues' until release.
optional: Often paired with separate pledge agreements, guaranties, and intercreditor agreements

contracts.name: Separation & Release Agreement
contracts.blurb: The employment agreement's exit door: severance is the consideration, the release is the product. Two-document architecture — agreement plus a separately executed Release exhibit with the ADEA/OWBPA machinery (21-day consideration, 7-day revocation).

sub: Conditioned on execution and non-revocation of Release
General release: Title VII, ADEA, ERISA, FMLA, ADA, state statutes
Covenant not to sue — EEOC / whistleblower carve-outs
Often mutual — company directs officers not to disparage

optional: Release executed as separate Exhibit A, signable only on/after separation date

contracts.name: Underwriting Agreement
contracts.blurb: Capital markets: the company and selling shareholders sell to a syndicate of underwriters. Signature machinery — over-allotment (greenshoe) option, comfort letters and triple legal opinions as closing conditions, lock-ups, '33 Act indemnification with a Contribution fallback, and underwriter-default substitution.

headings.t: Sale and Delivery to Underwriters; Closing

sub: Delivery of registration statements and prospectuses
Restriction on sale of securities (market standoff)
Legal opinions: company, sellers', underwriters' counsel

optional: Schedules: underwriter syndicate, selling shareholders
Exhibits: opinion forms, lock-up letter form
Price determination agreement
